test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Hitopadesha tales are written in a reader-friendly style, which perhaps_______ to their success.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. '**contributed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about Hitopadesha tales and it was successful literary work because of its reader-friendly style.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'contributed'.
 
• The word 'contributed' means **'****to be one of the reasons why something happens; to give something, especially money, in order to provide or achieve something together with other people.'**
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Ratan Tata **contributed** crores of money to the development of India.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Complete Sentence:__ *Hitopadesha tales are written in a reader-friendly style, which perhaps __**contributed**__ to their success.*
